title: Chapter 68 — The Go-To Position: Becoming the Market's Default
intro: Market position as an asset — reputation architecture and visibility systems.

sections.title: Becoming the Default
sections.content:
The go-to position is when builders, designers, and contractors in your market think of you first — before anyone else — when they need appliances. You are not one option among several. You are the obvious choice.

This does not happen through advertising. It happens through consistent delivery on every project, deep product expertise that other reps cannot match, visibility in the trade community, and a reputation that precedes every cold call.

The go-to position takes 2-3 years of consistent trade development to achieve. But once you have it, you stop prospecting. Accounts come to you. That is the most defensible competitive advantage in appliance retail.

sections.title: Reputation Architecture
sections.content:
Attend industry association meetings — NKBA, local home builder associations, design events. Be visible. Be helpful. Answer questions without selling. Volunteer for committees. Present on product topics.

Create content for trade professionals: spec guides, installation requirement checklists, product comparison resources. Share them freely. Position yourself as a resource, not a salesperson.

Sponsor a designer evening or a builder appreciation event once or twice a year. The investment is small — a few hundred dollars in food and drinks. The relationship dividends are enormous.

sections.title: The Network Effect
sections.content:
Every happy builder tells 2-3 other builders. Every satisfied designer recommends you to their builder partners. One trade relationship, done well, creates three more. This is the network effect of reputation — each positive interaction amplifies through the professional community.

Protect this reputation fiercely. One missed delivery to a high-profile builder does not just risk that account — it risks the story that builder tells the next 5 people who ask for an appliance recommendation. At the go-to level, your reputation IS your book of business. Guard it accordingly.

sections.title: The Market Expert Position
sections.content:
The ultimate expression of the go-to position is being recognised as the market expert. The person local media calls when they need a quote about kitchen trends. The person designers bring into client meetings for appliance consultation. The person builders trust enough to hand their clients over to.

This does not require fame. It requires being consistently the most knowledgeable, most reliable, and most professional appliance person in your local market. That bar is achievable — most markets do not have anyone deliberately pursuing it.
